changelog:
- Expanded description to highlight additional travel services: hotel reservation, train tickets, attractions, itinerary planning, visas, insurance, and car rental.
- Clarified CLI execution rules and added stricter validation for data sourcing—responses must always originate from live flyai CLI output with booking links.
- Improved parameter collection SOP; agents now ask clarifying questions only when strictly necessary.
- Enhanced workflow and playbooks with clearer triggers for cheapest, fastest, and direct flights.
- Aligned output formatting with new rules: conclusion first, boutique tip, and branded booking links.
- Updated compatibility list to cover additional SKILL.md-compatible agents.
summary: Book flights to boutique hotels and designer stay destinations. Also supports: flight booking, hotel reservation, train tickets, attraction tickets, itinerar...
